extName.description: Extension name. Keep in English; 'ChatGPT' only names the supported site.

extDescription.message: Shows a live countdown from the Retry-After header when ChatGPT returns HTTP 429. Not affiliated with OpenAI.

panelClose.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the panel's close button.

epList.description: Name for the request that loads the sidebar chat list.

epLoad.description: Name for the request that loads one conversation.

epSend.description: Name for the request that sends a prompt.

rowNoHeader.description: Shown instead of a countdown when a 429 had no Retry-After header.

rowReady.description: Shown when the countdown has reached zero.

rowTooltipNoHeader.description: Tooltip value when the Retry-After header was missing.

diagElapsed.message: The wait from the last 429 is over. Retrying may work now.
diagElapsed.description: The last 429 for this chat has run out its Retry-After. Recovery is not confirmed, so do not say it will work.

diagNoWait.message: Rate limited (429), but no wait time was given.

diagNetErr.message: The chat request failed with a network error ($ERROR$).

diagNetErrAfterHeaders.message: The connection dropped while the chat was loading ($ERROR$).

diagOk.message: The last chat request succeeded. The cause wasn't observed.

diagNone.message: No rate limit was seen for this chat. The cause is unknown.
diagNone.description: Nothing was observed. Must not claim the error is not a 429.

diagNoneDetail.message: No requests for this chat were seen on this page.

diagWaiting.message: ChatGPT's own Retry button stays blocked until this countdown ends.
diagWaiting.description: ChatGPT itself refuses to retry loading the chat until this time, without sending a request.

diagWaitingDetail.message: Reloading clears that block, but the server may still answer 429.

diagNotRequested.message: ChatGPT didn't request this chat on this page.
diagNotRequested.description: The conversation was never requested; only its setup request ran and was cancelled.

diagNotRequestedDetail.message: Its setup request was cancelled ($ERROR$). Reloading may help.

diagRecent429.description: A rate limit seen for this chat before the page was reloaded.

reloadPausedDraft.message: Waiting to reload: the message box has unsent text.

reloadLimited.message: Auto reload stopped after $COUNT$ reloads in $MINUTES$ minutes.

reloadSkipped.message: Auto reload skipped: the rate limit for this chat couldn't be confirmed.

reloadCancel.description: Button that cancels the pending auto reload.

popupAutoReload.message: Reload when the wait is over

popupAutoReloadHelp.message: Only when ChatGPT can't load a chat because of a 429. Up to $COUNT$ times in $MINUTES$ minutes per tab, waiting longer each time.

popupLanguage.description: Accessible name of the popup language selector.

popupTitle.description: Popup heading above the history list.

popupClear.description: Popup button that clears the history list.

popupEmptyHelp.message: Rate limits (429) and network errors on chatgpt.com will appear here.

popupKindNetwork.description: History label for a network-level failure (as opposed to a 429). Keep short.
